resources.string: The model returned no reply or action. Nothing was sent to the phone. Try a new task or select another available model.
A little help, a lot more time.
Reads selected app screens and performs actions you approve. Cloud models receive filtered screen content. Passwords, payments and security decisions stay manual.
What would you like to do?

MagicPhone can read and control only the apps you choose. Android Accessibility access is powerful: screen text and images may contain private information. Selected context, your task and attachments are sent to your chosen model provider. Detection cannot remove every secret. Review each action, keep secrets and payment authorization manual, and use Stop at any time. No ads, analytics or developer backend.
Enable MagicPhone manually in Accessibility settings. If Android restricts a sideloaded app, open its App info menu and allow restricted settings yourself. Return here after enabling.
%1$.1f s total · Model requests: %2$d\nModel/network: %3$.1f s · Phone/tools, including approval waits: %4$.1f s

Open apps, tap, scroll and enter ordinary text without selecting apps or approving each action. Explicitly blocked apps stay blocked. Android permission decisions stay manual. Detected password fields are blocked while sensitive-content checks are on. Access stays on until you turn it off.
Read and Act are allowed automatically unless blocked. Your individual choices return when automatic access is off.
Skip individual approvals for semantic taps, scrolling and opening this app for 5 minutes. Text and coordinates always need approval.
Eligible ChatGPT plans can authorize usage. Models and limits depend on your account. Sign in with your own account in the browser.
Use selected secondary model for this task
Install the separate MagicPhone Practice APK. This deterministic demo reads and taps its counter, with your approval. No model request.
This task was interrupted. Its last action may have completed. Resume starts with inspection; no action is replayed automatically.
Bounded JSON steps with typed parameters. No loops, shell, filesystem or network. Every action uses the same approvals. Imported scripts are inactive until reviewed.
Disabled until you configure a server and review its tools. Each call shows its destination and arguments for approval. Tool changes require new review.

Your selected provider receives tasks, attachments and filtered observations. MCP servers receive approved tool arguments. OpenAI receives OAuth sign-in requests. Local encrypted history stays on this phone unless you export it.
Credentials, destinations, permissions and grants are excluded. Imported notes need review; scripts stay inactive. Conversations are added with new IDs.
The operation could not be completed. Check your connection and settings, then try again. No uncertain action is replayed.
This action is blocked by your current app permissions. Review Settings → Access or Apps.
The screen kept changing while choosing an action. Wait for it to settle, then retry the task.
The target is covered by another window or outside the visible app area. Choose an unobstructed target.
The app screen cannot be read reliably. Close any popup, keyboard, notification shade or other overlay, keep the app visible, then retry.
A password field is visible. Complete the sign-in step manually.
Sign in again; your session is missing or expired.
Your provider reports a usage limit or unavailable plan usage. Review your account limits.
The action status is uncertain. Inspect the app manually before continuing.
Choose a model connection and a model in Settings first.
Signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed; disconnect MagicPhone in ChatGPT Settings.
Describe your task. Review the text in MagicPhone before sending.
Voice input is unavailable. Enable a speech recognition app in Android settings, or use your keyboard microphone.
The conversation changed while listening. Please dictate again in this chat.
No speech was recognized. Please try again.

Tap the microphone in the message field to dictate with your Android speech provider. It may process audio online. Review the draft before sending. Read aloud below a response or in its bubble uses your Android text-to-speech engine, which may also work online. Tap Stop reading to end playback.

Pause, Resume and Stop are in an ongoing notification while Accessibility is connected. Tap the notification to open the current chat. Android may let you dismiss it; opening MagicPhone restores it. Enable notifications to keep these controls available outside the app.
Choose which apps MagicPhone can read and control. Block always takes priority.
Help me find a setting on my phone
Models returned by your connection. Some usable models may be missing; manual options let you select them.
No matching models. Refresh the list or enable manual model options.
Your model, your preferences, your phone.
This model uses its default thinking settings. No supported levels are advertised.
Choose a supported setting or enable manual model options to request a level or speed beyond the fetched list.
Tell MagicPhone what you need. It can open apps and take care of the steps with you.
A little help.\nA lot less tapping.
Choose models and settings beyond the fetched list. Availability depends on your connection; the provider may reject a choice or use its default.
Using fetched capabilities and documented model defaults. Enable manual options for additional models, thinking levels and speeds.
Fast and Ultrafast may consume more usage or cost more. The last response shows what the server actually reports.
Includes manual model presets alongside fetched models. You can also enter a custom model ID.
The response did not confirm the requested speed.
You control what MagicPhone can do.

MagicPhone is an open-source automation tool provided without warranties, to the extent permitted by law. AI-generated instructions and automated actions can be wrong and may cause loss or damage. The authors and contributors disclaim liability where legally permitted. You are responsible for your requests, permissions, and automation settings. Review important actions and supervise tasks, especially when automatic access is enabled.
Show a floating message when a task completes or stops with a final error. Tap it to return to that chat. Questions that need your answer still show their own bubbles.
The task has finished. Open the chat to review the result.
What should I do on this screen?
Uses the current app after Send. Your existing app permissions apply.
The current app changed or is not allowed. Open the screen you want and check its Read permission, then try again.
Text-to-speech is unavailable. Check your Android speech engine in system settings.
This voice is not installed. Download it in Android text-to-speech settings.
Reading the available screen content. Continuing…
This system or permission screen needs manual input.

On: block detected password fields and sensitive screens. Off: allow reading and actions there; visible sensitive information may be sent to your selected model. App permissions, screen lock and Android screenshot protection still apply.
An action was sent, but its result could not be verified from the current screen. The action was not repeated.
The requested control or action could not be matched to the current screen.
The task reached its action or recovery limit. Check the latest observed result before continuing.
The model repeatedly returned an invalid action request. No action from those responses was executed.
Tap the visible app window to focus it before continuing.
Photo unavailable on this device. Attach it again if needed.
Photo storage is full. Delete unused conversations before attaching more photos.
This model cannot read photos. Choose an image-capable model; your draft has been kept.
Your reply could not be saved or delivered. Your draft has been kept. Please try again.

Uploaded photos are encrypted on this device and kept with their conversations. Deleting a conversation removes photos no other conversation uses. Automatic screen captures remain temporary. Encrypted backups currently include text and photo references, but not photo files.
